name: x402receipts
description: Accounting and reconciliation for autonomous spending. Every x402 purchase an agent makes becomes a receipt, matched against the on-chain transaction, with missing or unmatched payments flagged, monthly statements and exports for finance, and independently verifiable evidence. USD 0.01 per agent wallet for each day it records, paid over x402 by the agent's own wallet, at most USD 0.31 a month; no API key.
